info.title: Globetrot API
info.description: Operations of the Globetrot application. Authenticated with the session cookie set by `/api/auth/*`; the caller is always the session owner and no request field can name another user.

cookieAuth.name: globetrot.session_token
cookieAuth.description: The session cookie set by sign-in (`__Secure-globetrot.session_token` over https). Browsers send it by themselves.

get.summary: Which social sign-in buttons to show

put.description: Sends the route as it should be, in order. The server assigns ids and positions, so sending the same route twice changes nothing. At most 100 stops. An empty list clears the route. The first stop marked visited in a country stamps a commemorative visa (never an official document); the stamps this change gave are in `stampedVisas`.

nights.description: Nights spent here. Day trips are 0.

note.description: The person’s note about the stop. Blank is no note.

legMode.description: How they travel from this stop to the next. Ignored on the last stop.

visited.description: The person marked it visited (their word, not a verification). The first visited stop in a country stamps a commemorative visa.

spotRoute.description: Draw the route between this stop's spots that have a place: A, B, C… in the order of `spots`, straight lines.

kind.description: What the spot is, for its mini-pin: stay (where you sleep), food, sight, shop, transport (a station or airport) or other. Defaults to sight.

todos.description: Things to do for this stop (at most 30).

alt.description: What the photo shows, for people who cannot see it. Blank is allowed.

photos.description: The stop's photos (at most 12): images the caller uploaded (`POST /v1/media`).

destinations.description: The whole route, in order (at most 100 stops).

200.description: The route as stored, and the visas it stamped.

post.description: The amount is in `currency`. When that is not the trip’s currency, send `fxRate` (how much of the trip’s currency 1 unit is worth); the server converts, and keeps the rate, its source (`manual`) and its date with the cost. The converted amount is never taken from the client. `guess: true` marks the rough guess of the whole trip (at most one per trip): totals count it minus every other cost, never below zero.

amount.description: Major units as a decimal string.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Defaults to USD.

fxRate.description: Required when `currency` is not the trip’s: how much of the trip’s currency 1 unit of `currency` is worth.

fxAsOf.description: The day the rate was taken. Defaults to today.

paidBy.description: On a trip planned together, who paid it: the owner’s or a member’s user id (ADR-0025). Null clears it.

guess.description: True for the rough guess of the whole trip (at most one per trip). It counts minus every other cost, never below zero, so real costs replace it instead of adding on top.
